name: wave
note: 09 Wave (references/packaging/09_wave.png, designer sketch 2026-11-12): 100 mm cube, lift-off lid. seam_profile is the seam height above seam_low_z (mm) at s = 0, 0.1 ... 1 along each face, s = 0 at a side corner (x = y = opposite signs) and s = 1 at the front / back corner, measured from the sketch (closed box and lifted lid agree within ~2 mm): level at the side corners, crest ~15 mm just before mid-face, a small dip near 80 %, rising again to ~9 mm at the front / back corner. Off the walls s = acos(q) / pi with q = -sin(pi x / size) sin(pi y / size), interpolated Catmull-Rom. A `reveal` gap along the wave shows a cream inner collar, set back by the lid wall, that rises `collar_rise` above the wave into the lid. Wave edges rounded with edge_radius. Outside and lining get the Select look in the job.

materials.note: glTF-safe placeholders (kraft outside, white inside, Paper002 grain); the job swaps in the Select look for the GLB and the renders.
